locations.note: Yagami's agency and the Genda Law Office are in Kamurocho, the series' Kabukicho, where Shirosaki asks him to break the groping alibi of Ehara, a police officer tied to a body found in Yokohama; Kaito's own case in The Kaito Files starts there too.
Yagami goes undercover at Seiryo High School in Ijincho, the series' Isezakicho in Yokohama, to expose its bullying, chases the handyman Kuwana and fights the RK gang across the district.
